llm.summary: The skill's code and instructions align with its stated purpose (scraping Korean government program pages into JSONL with checkpoints); it does not request credentials or install external binaries, but my confidence is medium because the provided collect.py was truncated in the prompt so I could not see every line of the file.

dimensions.detail: The name/description (collect Korean government support programs into JSONL with checkpoints) matches the included scripts and SKILL.md. collect.py implements page-by-page fetching, parsing, deduplication by title, checkpointing (.checkpoint.json), and append-only JSONL output as advertised. The code targets the same sites listed in SKILL.md.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs running scripts/collect.py and provides usage examples; the script's runtime behavior is limited to fetching public web pages, parsing HTML, writing JSONL and a checkpoint file, and printing logs. It does not instruct reading unrelated system files or exfiltrating data to external endpoints. It explicitly skips JS-rendered sites and notes Selenium/Playwright would be required for those.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec; this is an instruction+script package relying only on Python standard library and a small bash helper. No remote download/extraction or third‑party package installation was requested in the metadata — low installation risk.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables or credentials (which is appropriate). The code optionally reads GOV_SCRAPER_UA to override the User-Agent header; that environment variable is non-sensitive and not required. No credentials, tokens, or other secrets are requested or used.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request permanent inclusion (always:false), does not modify other skills or system-wide settings, and only writes to the user-specified output directory and its own .checkpoint.json. Append-only behavior reduces risk of accidental overwrite.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent and implements what it claims, but take these precautions before running it: 1) Review the full collect.py (the provided prompt truncated part of the file) to confirm there are no unexpected network calls or subprocess executions. 2) Run it in a sandbox or non-privileged account and point --output to a dedicated directory. 3) Start with a small --max-pages to verify behavior and avoid heavy scraping. 4) Respect target sites' robots.txt, rate limits and legal terms; the script uses a 0.8s delay but adjust if needed. 5) If you later add Selenium/Playwright to handle skipped JS sites, only install official drivers and be aware those require browser binaries. 6) No credentials are needed; check for any environment variables the script might read (it supports GOV_SCRAPER_UA to override User-Agent). If you want higher assurance, provide the full (untruncated) collect.py for a line-by-line review.
